lead.t: The PUJ is one of the three classic anatomical narrowings of the ureter (along with the pelvic brim crossing the iliac vessels, and the vesicoureteric junction), and the most common site of obstruction (e.g., PUJ obstruction).
lead.s: Male Reproductive & Urinary Tract Pathology Questions MKU Year 3

snip.t: Vesicoureteric junction (VUJ): Antireflux mechanism; obstruction or reflux ↑ risk
Site of impaction predicts the pain: at the pelviureteric junction, pelvic brim (crossing the iliac vessels) and vesicoureteric junction (the three narrowest points).

snip.t: A stone at the vesicoureteric junction causes frequency, urgency, dysuria, strangury and pain at the tip of the penis.
